description: This is a test source file for the ModuleUtil class in the openmrs-core project, specifically testing various utility functions related to module management, version compatibility, resource handling, and jar expansion.

classes.name: ModuleUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various static methods of the ModuleUtil class in the openmrs module system.

methods.name: checkMandatoryModulesStarted_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfAMandatoryModuleIsNotStarted
methods.description: Tests that the system throws an exception if mandatory modules are not started.

methods.name: getMandatoryModules_shouldReturnMandatoryModuleIds
methods.description: Verifies that mandatory modules are correctly identified based on global properties.

methods.name: isOpenmrsVersionInVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenVersionsIsNull
methods.description: Ensures version check returns false if version array is null.

methods.name: isOpenmrsVersionInVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenVersionsIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures version check returns false if version array is empty.

methods.name: isOpenmrsVersionInVersions_shouldReturnTrueIfCurrentOpenmrsVersionMatchesOneElementInVersions
methods.description: Checks if current version matches one of the specified version patterns.

methods.name: getPathForResource_shouldHandleUiSpringmvcCssUiDotCssExample
methods.description: Tests that the resource path is correctly computed for UI resources.

methods.name: getModuleForPath_shouldHandleUiSpringmvcCssUiDotCssWhenUiDotSpringmvcModuleIsRunning
methods.description: Ensures correct module retrieval based on resource path when specific modules are active.

methods.name: checkRequiredVersion_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfOpenmrsVersionBeyondWildCardRange
methods.description: Tests exception throwing when version exceeds required range.

methods.name: compareVersion_shouldCorrectlyComparingTwoVersionNumbers
methods.description: Checks version comparison logic for different version strings.

methods.name: file2url_shouldReturnNullIfFileIsNull
methods.description: Verifies null handling in file to URL conversion.

methods.name: getPackagesFromFile_shouldReturnEmptyStringSetIfNonJarFile
methods.description: Checks package extraction from non-JAR files.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenVersionBeyondWildCardRange
methods.description: Tests version matching failure when outside version boundary.
